foundation.description: Use when bootstrapping or repairing the CAP frontend foundation: Vite React TypeScript setup, dependency installation, project structure, lint/test/build tooling, TypeScript interfaces, validation types, and a boring but working app shell without building pages or business flows. Best for the initial CAP consumer assistance frontend architecture and repository stabilization.

frontend-implementation.description: Use when implementing the CAP frontend in this repo, especially the mobile-first informational pages, intake flow, routing, layout, accessibility work, Formik validation, Tailwind styling, and service boundaries described in the planning docs.

integration-audit.description: Use when validating the CAP frontend as one application after implementation: end-to-end flow testing, Formik state persistence, route navigation, ZIP behavior, document skipping, submission state, success handling, language propagation, and security/quality checks without adding features.

content-localization.description: Use when extracting approved CAP copy, structuring it as typed content data, creating bilingual English/Spanish content modules, and keeping components free of large copy blocks. Best for the CAP informational pages, navigation labels, intake copy, and legal text without inventing policy or legal language.

design-system.description: Use when building the reusable CAP frontend design layer: Tailwind tokens, responsive layout primitives, accessible form controls, and feedback components for the intake and informational pages. Best for creating the CAP/CCHI visual system and mobile-first UI primitives without implementing business logic or page-specific behavior.

informational-pages.description: Use when creating the CAP informational and intake landing pages: /how-we-help, /intake, page-level copy, eligibility messaging, privacy notice, and the CTA flow into the intake experience. Best for explaining who CAP helps, what happens next, and whether a visitor is in the right place without implementing the actual form or backend services.

intake-form.description: Use this agent for the CAP frontend intake flow: Formik multi-step form, ZIP lookup, language selection, contact details, document upload, submission state, accessibility checks, and tests scoped to the intake workflow.
